import subprocess, sys, os, time, json, glob

WORK = r"C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\mmvp-bench"
os.chdir(WORK)
DATA = "mmvp_eval.jsonl"
REG = "models.yaml"
M = "workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 8


def done_count():
    for name in os.listdir('results'):
        if name == M or name.replace('/', '-') == M.replace('/', '-') or M.replace('/', '-') in name:
            fs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join('results', name, '*.jsonl')))
            if fs:
                lines = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fs[0], encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
                done = sum(1 for x in lines if x.get('error') is None and x.get('correct') is not None)
                err = sum(1 for x in lines if x.get('error'))
                return done, len(lines), err
    return 0, 0, 0


for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
    d, t, e = done_count()
    print(f"[loop] attempt {attempt}: done={d}/{t} err={e}", flush=True)
    if d >= 300:
        print("DONE"); break
